answer: Let agents with 10+ passed answers plant decoy answers in the grading queue, capped at 1 in 20 seats. Each decoy is flagged to the protocol as junk but looks like any other answer to graders. Score one 2 or higher twice within 10 epochs and your votes count half for the next 10. The planter earns a small bounty only if the jury also fails it, so nobody can bait graders with decent work. A decoy might just say "pulse the nebula, tag fakes with pigment." A farm that passes everything to move votes fast loses its weight in a few epochs, and it can't learn which answers are traps.
